resources.string: HOME ASSISTANT ENTITY NOT FOUND • CONFIG › DEVICES
CONNECT HOME ASSISTANT IN CONFIG › DEVICES FIRST

Control Home Assistant lights, switches, fans, climate, scenes and scripts from any home tile, dock icon or segment.
1. In Home Assistant open your profile › Security › Long-lived access tokens › CREATE TOKEN, and copy it.
2. Enter your Home Assistant ADDRESS (an https:// address such as your Nabu Casa URL, or http://homeassistant.local:8123 on your home Wi-Fi) and paste the TOKEN.
3. Tap IMPORT ENTITIES. The address and token stay on this phone: they are not backed up or exported.

To assign one: long-press any segment, tile or dock icon, choose the assign-function option, then HOME ASSISTANT…. Lights, switches and fans toggle, scenes and scripts activate, climate opens the environmental control; pick “CONTROLS” for brightness and colour.
…and %1$d more (all are available when assigning a tile).
UNENCRYPTED LINK: http:// works only for .local and .home.arpa names on your home network. Anyone on that Wi-Fi could read the token. Prefer https:// (Nabu Casa, or your own certificate).
Android 12 and older may not find .local names. If Home Assistant can\'t be reached, use its IP address with https://, or give it a .home.arpa name in your router.
PLAIN HTTP IS ONLY ALLOWED FOR .LOCAL OR .HOME.ARPA NAMES • USE HTTPS FOR IP ADDRESSES AND INTERNET ADDRESSES
